# pantechdynamics_instance (Data Source)

Looks up one existing instance by id or name, for example to point a public IP, volume or database access rule at a machine Terraform does not manage. Deleted instances are not found.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Look an existing instance up by id (or by name). Instance names are not unique:
# if several share the name, the lookup fails and lists their ids.
data "pantechdynamics_instance" "app" {
  name = "app-1"
}

output "app_private_address" {
  value = data.pantechdynamics_instance.app.private_ipv4
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Id of the instance to look up, starting with vm_. Set exactly one of id and name.
- `name` (String) Name of the instance to look up. It must match exactly. Names are not unique on the platform: if more than one instance has the name, the lookup fails and lists their ids. Set exactly one of id and name.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) When the instance was created, in RFC 3339 UTC, to the second.
- `desired_state` (String) "running" or "stopped", as last requested.
- `image_slug` (String) Image the instance was created from.
- `network_id` (String) VPC network of the instance, or null for a standard instance.
- `observed_state` (String) State of the instance as the platform sees it, for example "running".
- `plan_slug` (String) Plan the instance runs on.
- `private_ipv4` (String) IPv4 address of the instance on its network.
- `public_ipv4` (String) Public IPv4 address, or null when the instance has none.
- `region` (String) Region the instance is in.
- `security_group_id` (String) Security group of a standard instance.
- `subnet_id` (String) VPC subnet of the instance, or null for a standard instance.
- `tags` (Map of String) Key and value labels of the instance.
- `zone` (String) Zone the instance is in.
